description:
Skill Hub gathers the skills and prompts scattered across Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Agents, Proma and other AI coding tools into one window.

The more skills you install, the harder it gets to remember where each one lives, which ones are duplicates, and which symlinks broke months ago. Skill Hub scans ~/.cursor, ~/.claude, ~/.codex, ~/.agents and friends, recognises the same skill installed in several places, and merges them into a single record.

Features
• See everything at once: skills cluster by name prefix into a bubble map sized by how often you actually open them; click to drill down
• Read and edit: preview rendered SKILL.md, switch to edit mode, save in place
• Install into other tools: link or copy a skill into another tool's folder with one click
• Deduplicate: find the same skill installed several times, keep one real copy, remove the extra links
• Health checks: flag skills missing a description and broken symlinks
• Prompt library: collect prompts embedded in skills and standalone prompts; star, tag, and save copies
• Archive instead of delete: move unused skills to ~/.skill-hub/archive and bring them back any time

Privacy
Skill Hub runs entirely on your Mac. It never connects to the network and collects no data. You grant access to your home folder once on first launch; after that it only reads and writes the skill folders inside it. Stars, tags, and notes stay on this Mac.
promotionalText: Scan every AI coding tool's skills on your Mac. Cluster, deduplicate, edit, archive—one window.
